pages.title: Dragonskin
pages.text: The $(thing)Ender Dragon$() drops 6 to 10 in this pack. A hull that has flown the void can hold it out.

pages.title: How
pages.text: Reach the End through a Stronghold portal and fight the dragon. Ranged builds help: arrows or autocannon shots break the healing crystals. To fight again, place four End Crystals on the exit portal to bring the dragon back.

pages.title: Related
pages.text: The road, and where this prize lives.
